title: Senator John Cornyn highlights healthcare and agriculture initiatives in October 2025 posts - Houston Republic
text:
Senator John Cornyn highlighted recent developments in Texas healthcare and agriculture through a series of posts on October 8, 2025. Cornyn, who has served as U.S. Senator for Texas since 2002, used his social media platform to congratulate Texas Children’s Hospital, discuss rural health initiatives, and meet with agricultural representatives.
On October 8, 2025, Cornyn congratulated a leading medical institution, stating, “Congratulations to @TexasChildrens on being named the #1 children’s hospital in Texas by @usnews! This is a testament to the excellence of the entire Texas Children’s team. Thank you for all you do to bring hope & healing to families in the Lone Star State & beyond.”
Later that day, Cornyn addressed rural healthcare efforts, posting, “The #OBBB established a $50 billion rural health transformation program to strengthen access to care & modernize health systems in rural areas. I enjoyed discussing with representatives from the Texas Council of Community Centers how this will enhance care for rural Texas” on October 8, 2025.
In a separate post, Cornyn discussed agricultural trade, writing, “Great to meet with @SorghumGrowers to discuss how we can help Texas producers gain market access for sorghum exports & ensure they have the support they need.” on October 8, 2025.
Cornyn’s ongoing engagement with healthcare and agriculture reflects his long tenure in Texas politics. He has secured re-election multiple times, including victories over MJ Hegar in 2020, David Alameel in 2014, Rick Noriega in 2008, and Ron Kirk in 2002. These electoral wins have allowed him to maintain a significant presence in policy discussions relevant to Texans across sectors.
